name: I Fear No Man
aka: But That Thing, It Scares Me
look: Dark, grainy panels from Team Fortress 2. Top: the hulking Heavy sits in silhouette before window blinds, subtitled "I fear no man." Bottom left: he looks aside, "But that thing...". Bottom middle: an empty white square. Bottom right: he grips his face nervously, "it scares me."
use: The big, tough Heavy admits there is exactly one thing he's afraid of. The empty white square gets a picture or name of that thing, usually something small, silly or relatable.
slots: the empty white square: the one thing that scares him
examples: A text from mom that just says "call me"
describe: big man in the dark says i fear no man but that thing scares me
heavy from team fortress sitting in a dark room afraid
silhouette of a giant guy by window blinds admitting a fear
tough guy scared of one thing with a blank square to fill
tf2 heavy covering his mouth nervously in the shadows
origin: From Valve's 2012 "Meet the Pyro" video for Team Fortress 2, where the Heavy admits that the Pyro scares him.
